alignment_reasoning: The image is a clear case of class mismatch. The target class is 'airship' (rigid, elongated, propelled), but the generated image is a 'hot air balloon' (spherical, unpropelled). The `fine_grained_classifier` ironically ranked 'airship' first, likely due to the 'lighter-than-air' semantic overlap, but the visual evidence (spherical shape, wicker basket) definitively contradicts the taxonomy. Only 1/9 checkpoints passed (surface advertising). This is a catastrophic alignment failure, similar to Reference 1 (bannister) where the object type is wrong, though the image quality is higher than Ref 1.
